units.source_text: 但令女性魂牽夢繞的氣息圍繞在我身體的某一處，

en.t: Yet it was true that somewhere about my body there clung an air that made women dream of me,

units.source_text: 不是隨口胡謅的玩笑，而是不容否定的事實。

en.t: not some idle boast or careless joke, but an undeniable fact.

units.source_text: 這一點被堀木看穿時，我感到屈辱般的痛苦，同時，也對尋花問柳失去了興致。

en.t: When Horiki saw through this, I felt a bitterness like humiliation, and at the same time I lost all interest in going out with women.

units.source_text: 有一天，堀木再次出於趕時髦的虛榮（對堀木而言，除了這個理由外，我至今仍無法去思考其他理由），

en.t: One day, Horiki again, out of a vain desire to be fashionable, for even now I can think of no other reason in his case,

units.source_text: 帶我去參加了一個祕密研究會的「共產主義讀書會」（大概叫R.S吧，我記不太清楚了）。

en.t: took me to a secret study society, a Communist reading group, I believe it was called R.S., though I do not remember clearly.

units.source_text: 也許對於堀木這樣的人而言，共產主義的祕密聚會，說不定與「遊覽東京」的一處景點沒什麼區別。

en.t: Perhaps for someone like Horiki, a secret Communist gathering was no different from one stop on a tour of Tokyo.
